newsitem.title: JAPAN: S'tomo Bank to write off 200 bln yen problem loans.
newsitem.headline: S'tomo Bank to write off 200 bln yen problem loans.

text.p: Sumitomo Bank Ltd will write off problem loans totalling more than 200 billion yen in the current business year to March 31, 1997, a senior bank official told a news conference on Friday.
The official said the bank had decided to increase the write off amount for the business year from the more than 100 billion yen it forecast in May, due to falling land prices.
The official added that the bank no longer needed to provide financial help to its affiliated non-bank financial institutions.
